thread:
Noah (CS): Heads-up — onboarding webhooks in EU returned 400 signature errors for a ~25m window this morning. Need a short customer note + renewal risk flagging for any at-risk deals.
Tom (Eng): Root cause: verification library bump changed default header parsing; some older SDK integrations sent legacy sig format. Deployed compatibility shim at 08:42 UTC; full rollback not required.
Rina (Solutions): For comms let's separate: (A) customers who received failures while onboarding (likely lost events), (B) customers with intermittent errors but completed onboarding. Provide clear replay instructions for group A.
Hannah (Acct Exec): I have two renewals closing this week, one churn risk. Can we include a proactive remediation offer (credit + hands-on replay) in the renewal thread?
Noah (CS): Draft below — short, transparent, and gives a quick action path. Feedback welcome.
Noah (CS): ```
Hi {CustomerName},
Were reaching out about a short issue on {date} (approx 08:158:40 UTC) that caused webhook deliveries for some EU tenants to be rejected with signature verification errors. This mainly affected new integrations and first-time webhook deliveries.
Impact: missed webhook events during the window for new installs; customers with existing integrations generally saw no data loss.
What we did: deployed a compatibility shim to accept both legacy and new signature formats and validated successful deliveries after 08:42 UTC.
What you can do now:
- If you triggered an onboarding or integration during the window and are missing events, reply and well replay them for you.
- To replay yourself:
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/replay -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"tenant\":\"<id>\"}'

Were also offering targeted remediation for materially impacted customers, including replay assistance and a goodwill credit. If youd like a 1:1 with our engineers, tell us a preferred time and well arrange it.
Thanks,
Noah & Redwood Customer Success
```
Tom (Eng): tiny tweak: include incident link and incident ID. Also add a one-liner for customers using older SDKs: "upgrade SDK or contact us to enable compatibility shim."
Noah (CS): added. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-03-21-webhook-eu (ID: 2026-03-21-WEBHOOK-EU). Also added SDK note.
Rina (Solutions): Renewal blurb suggestion for Hannah: "Redwood has offered replay assistance and a goodwill credit (typical range $250$1,500). For high-risk renewals we recommend the upper band + a 30-min technical walkthrough to rebuild trust."
Hannah (Acct Exec): that works. Ill offer the 30-min walkthrough + $1,500 credit for the risky renewal.
ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-WEBHOOK-EU: status -> RESOLVED. Monitoring window: 12h.
